title: Teleport GUI Amy
features:
Teleport GUI (RECOMMEND YOU READ)

Target select
Farthest
Closest
Random
Random Friend (a random friend in the SAME server as you)
Raycasting (closest player in your FIELD OF VIEW)
None (when none is selected, the gui will assume the username inside the textbox, the textbox will take shortened usernames but not display names)

Minimize button
when minimized, there’s a small teleport button that will target the same player you had selected (if target closest and minimize your gui, pressing teleport WILL teleport to closest)

Inside (off means you teleport behind them, on means you teleport inside them)

Loop
This basically loops your teleport, you can choose how fast it is (per second) in the textbox beside it

Subcategory Targets
Team (targets team)
Neutral (targets all)
Enemies (targets non team)

TPTOOL
gives urself a tool that when u hold out, u can click somewhere to teleport, press this button again to remove the tool

auto avoid
avoids players within the circle unless whitelisted in the dropdown box via username 
automatically refers to the subcategory to avoid players
avoids by teleporting away from the target when the target enters range

Source is in the discord
